name: Earl Grey
siboNotes: Pure Earl Grey tea is SIBO-friendly and may have mild antimicrobial properties from bergamot oil. Avoid adding high FODMAP sweeteners or milk.
preparationTips: Steep tea bag or loose tea for 3-5 minutes in hot water
Use lactose-free milk or small amounts of regular milk (up to 1/4 cup)
Sweeten with maple syrup, stevia, or small amounts of table sugar
Avoid honey, agave, or artificial sweeteners containing sorbitol or mannitol
